status: Partial native stationary unipolar coil results; no jetting claim

air_inductance.method:
Independent thin round-wire Neumann energy estimate for generated CAD coils.

This is a lumped circuit parameter estimate, not a volumetric EM solver.
The softened filament uses a*exp(-1/4), matching low-frequency internal
inductance of a round, uniform-current wire. Skin/proximity corrections and
finite cross-section errors are not resolved. Compare discretizations and
the thin circular-loop asymptote before using circuit voltage estimates.
air_inductance.warning: Discretization agreement does not bound cross-section, skin, proximity, lead routing or conductor-reaction errors.

method: Interval V=R*meanI+(L_air+L_series)*deltaI/dt+delta(native reaction linkage)/dt. Exact linear-interval I2dt. Separate backward-Euler metal source-work identity from midpoint lumped-circuit net work.

native_force_integrals.scope: Trapezoidal integration of stationary liquid ROI forces. Neither a wall-pressure solution nor the impulse delivered to an expelled drop. Rise/fall cancellation can change when the interface moves.

stationary_current_projections.scope: Same waveform, geometry and fixed conductivity/permeability: field/linkage/voltage scale with I; force/Joule heat with I². Reuses the native stationary solution, not another field solver. No thermal, moving-interface or droplet scaling is inferred.

cases.scope: Static liquid force moment is not nozzle pressure or a droplet criterion. Rate200Hz is arithmetic only, not demonstrated repetition.

limits: Prescribed current; no switching, current-loop control, PWM ripple, capacitor or loaded circuit simulation.
AirL retains softened round-wire assumptions. Core radius used for circuit area is an explicit wire assumption; actual winding cross-section, hot resistance and lead routing need specification.
Interval voltages exclude switch-node overshoot. Negative voltage at positive current requires controlled recovery or a suitable clamp.
Metal reaction uses stationary initial conductivity, no thermal/motional evolution. No equality of fields/pressure in the moving meniscus is established.
200um cold screen is not spatial convergence. Inspect work-balance and numerical-loss sensitivity before selecting a flow waveform.
